translationRepairs: In the twelfth year (1886) the emperor assumed personal rule and ordered repairs to the Old Summer Palace for the empress dowager's residence.
In the twelfth year (1873) the emperor assumed personal rule and ordered repairs to the Old Summer Palace for the empress dowager's residence.

s0208 places 十二年 with 上親政 and 葺治圓明園 for the empress dowager, immediately followed by Shen Huai's and You Baichuan's remonstrance—the Tongzhi-era Yuanmingyuan repair debate. Tongzhi 12 is AD 1873; the prior parenthetical 1886 wrongly treats the year as Guangxu 12.
Lately the two Hu provinces have been held up chiefly by a few scholar-officials—Hu Linyi and Luo Zinan—who drilled their men in courage and led from the front.
Lately the two Hu provinces have been held up chiefly by a few scholar-officials—Hu Linyi and Luo Zenan—who drilled their men in courage and led from the front.
s0017 names 羅澤南 beside 胡林翼; 澤南 is Zenan, not Zinan. The proposed idiomatic correction restores the standard romanization without changing the rest of the sentence.
